source.quote: Por tercera temporada consecutiva, desde que dejó atrás a Adidas, Hummel es la firma encargada de las camisetas del Celta

summary: Front Estrella Galicia 0,0 (renewed 4 February 2026, relationship past 15 years); sleeve JP Financial (from August 2025, deal to 2028); back Abanca — the 2026-27 overview names Abanca on the back of two La Liga shirts, Celta's being the one that is not Deportivo's, and Abanca's //ABANCA back is visible in the club store's photos of the 2026-27 home shirt; kit maker Hummel, in its third season after Adidas. Abanca's wider deal (stadium naming Abanca Balaidos plus the secondary clothing sponsorship) is worth a little under EUR 2m a year combined and runs to 2028.
